anomalies.description: A vehicle (likely a truck or large SUV) on the left side of the highway loses control, veers sharply left, and collides with the concrete median barrier, generating a large cloud of dust and debris that spreads across multiple lanes. The impact is visible from frame f3 onward, with the dust plume expanding and persisting through f15.

A severe vehicle collision occurs on the left shoulder/median, generating a large dust cloud and scattering debris across the highway. A dark object (likely a vehicle or part thereof) is seen airborne or sliding near the barrier at f0–f2, with dust rapidly expanding.; Secondary impact or debris interaction: a dark object (possibly a tire or detached part) rolls across lanes from left to right between f3 and f7, passing in front of the camera vehicle around f5–f6, indicating ongoing post-collision dynamics.; Aftermath phase: dust continues to settle, multiple vehicles slow or change lanes; a damaged vehicle remains visible near the left barrier (e.g., f8–f15), and debris is scattered on the road surface. No new impacts observed, but the scene confirms a recent crash.

A severe vehicle collision has occurred on the left side of the highway, generating a large dust/debris cloud and visible wreckage (including a damaged barrier and scattered debris) near the left shoulder. Multiple vehicles ahead are slowing or stopping in response.; Ongoing aftermath of the crash: the dust cloud persists, traffic is heavily congested with vehicles braking and changing lanes, and additional vehicles (e.g., black SUV at f12, blue minivan at f15) enter the scene and react to the incident ahead.
A black sedan collides with the rear-left side of a white truck as the truck makes a left turn at an intersection, causing the sedan to spin and kick up dust/debris.

A dark-colored vehicle (possibly a motorcycle or small car) is seen on its side on the left edge of the road at t=32.0, with dust kicked up and a light truck swerving right to avoid it; by t=32.5 the dark vehicle is no longer visible in frame, suggesting it was struck or slid out of view immediately after impact.
The vehicle collides with a white truck approaching from the opposite direction on a narrow road; immediate windshield shattering and violent camera displacement confirm impact.

A white car on the right side of the road is seen veering sharply left and colliding with or coming to an abrupt stop against the roadside trees/vegetation, with visible displacement and loss of control. The vehicle appears to be a vintage sedan and is clearly off the roadway in frames f5–f6.

A dark object (likely a small animal) is struck by the vehicle from which the footage is recorded, visible on the road surface just ahead at t=117.0 (f11), then absent in subsequent frames; the impact is implied by sudden appearance and disappearance of the object in the lane, consistent with being hit and displaced. This qualifies as a vehicle collision with an object on the road.
